say: In India, welfare eligibility is decided by code, but the law lives in Marathi PDFs that keep changing. When the code falls behind, real people are wrongly cut off.
Niyam is an AI agent that reads each new government order and updates the rule code itself, with the source clause for every line.

Here it reads a real Marathi amendment and finds six changes. Claude Code updates the rules and tests, and a separate blind verifier checks them against the law: sixteen of sixteen agree. Anything that removes people waits for a human.
Entire saves every rule commit with the agent's full session, public, so anyone can see which agent and model wrote each line.
cfo.ai's agent, Ari, built our thirty six month plan from measured costs: about ninety five percent gross margin.
neatlogs traced every run and flagged the incidents our agent hit while we built it.
A runaway loop cost three dollars on one document. The trace showed the verifier never saw the benefit formula. We added it, plus a loop guard, and it now runs straight through.
Validation errors: answers cut off mid sentence. Now the agent retries with more room and recovers by itself.
A usage limit stopped a job half way. Now jobs pause, and resume from their last good step.
Cost per document fell from eighty eight cents to thirteen, with every check at one hundred percent.
And anyone can check their eligibility in Marathi, Hindi or English, right in the browser.
Niyam. When the law changes, the code changes with it.
